svg.text: Since Sep 27, 2026 · the reviewer prompts still change most weeks
Changes reviewed and PRs merged, per week
Real bugs still open at each judge pass, by age
Judge tokens per pass, by stage
Each review now logs its tokens and cost. Once a whole
week is logged, this panel plots the two reviewers'
tokens per week, next to the judge's in d.
Fan-out audit: does a fix need making elsewhere too · Convention check: does new code copy a helper or sit in the wrong place
* beside a hollow point or bar: a week still running, or under 10 sessions · * on its own: no tokens logged · tokens include cache reads
c: a real bug is one the verify agent called fix or decide (or found already fixed), or a stranded commit · fixed = gone at that pass, the first time since it was flagged
Data through Oct 28 · 177 sessions · how it is counted: docs/ai-assist/AGENT_RECORD.md
